title: Mitigating Gender Bias in Natural Language Processing: Literature Review

bias_targets.methodology: The paper is a literature review that covers multiple methodologies for measuring gender bias, including adapting psychological tests (like IAT into WEAT and SEAT) to measure subconscious associations in embeddings, analyzing geometric gender sub-spaces and cluster bias in vector spaces, and measuring downstream performance differences (e.g., False Positive/Negative Equality Difference) using gender-swapping and Gender Bias Evaluation Testsets (GBETs).
